coverage_matrix.deterministic: Applicable rulebook penalty service, duration, release, coincidence and manpower tables
coverage_matrix.estimable: Penalty frequency/type by observed state; overlap candidates from assessment clocks and nominal duration; shift return proxies
coverage_matrix.unobserved: PBP has no explicit Rule 19 adjudication label or canonical expiration/release event; nominal duration endpoint is not a verified service interval

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Restart placement when the source records the location and the applicable rule specifies it
coverage_matrix.estimable: Team/player faceoff win rates; next event; winner-team attempt before next faceoff and within 30 game-clock seconds
coverage_matrix.unobserved: Continuous possession, unrecorded passes and puck control between event records

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Clock arithmetic, interval ordering and eligible personnel constraints under the applicable rules
coverage_matrix.estimable: Shift duration, observed start/deployment rates and interval overlap; context is nearest preceding PBP state
coverage_matrix.observed_fields: Shift data rows: gameId/playerId/teamId/period/startTime/endTime/duration/typeCode/eventDescription; PBP rosterSpots playerId/teamId/positionCode
coverage_matrix.unobserved: Forward line/defensive pair labels, coaching intent, fatigue, and why a change was selected

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Personnel-count legality and rules for substitution/re-entry when all state is observed
coverage_matrix.estimable: Empty-net intervals and goalie-presence transitions by pre-event score/time, subject to shift reconciliation
coverage_matrix.observed_fields: PBP situationCode goalie/skater digits and shot goalieInNetId; shift playerId/teamId/period/startTime/endTime; PBP score and clock
coverage_matrix.unobserved: A shift endpoint alone does not prove a pull; actual target-game starter is not a valid pregame input here

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Score and SOG accounting; shootout goals separated from player regulation/OT goals
coverage_matrix.estimable: Attempt-event rate, attempt-to-SOG, SOG-to-goal, and recorded type/zone/strength/goalie conditional diagnostics
coverage_matrix.observed_fields: PBP event type goal/shot-on-goal/missed-shot/blocked-shot; shootingPlayerId/scoringPlayerId/goalieInNetId/xCoord/yCoord/zoneCode/shotType/situationCode; independent box-score team SOG and goals
coverage_matrix.unobserved: Attempts with no recorded PBP event and true release location for many blocked shots

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Restart consequence where event cause, zone and applicable rule inputs are explicit
coverage_matrix.estimable: Recorded stoppage reason frequency and ordered next-faceoff/restart sequence
coverage_matrix.observed_fields: PBP stoppage details.reason, event order/clock, following faceoff details.zoneCode/xCoord/yCoord; penalty and goal records
coverage_matrix.unobserved: Unrecorded whistles and geometric evidence to independently adjudicate icing/offside or other spatial calls

coverage_matrix.deterministic: Season-applicable OT clock, sudden-death termination, shootout paired attempts and early-clinch rules
coverage_matrix.estimable: Tie-to-OT, OT duration/goal and shootout occurrence/attempt/outcome distributions
coverage_matrix.observed_fields: PBP periodDescriptor/timeInPeriod/event type/team owner; official final box score and shootout events/attempts
coverage_matrix.unobserved: Decision policy for tactics and personnel unless identifiable from the observed event sequence

decision: development evidence and targeted rule correction only; no candidate selected, no validity gate changed, no adoption claim

deterministic_rule_transitions: period/clock boundaries and regular-season OT/SO path for the pinned rule edition
penalty durations, releases, manpower and restarts where the exact rule table inputs exist
empirical_behavior_to_estimate: faceoff outcomes and post-faceoff event sequences
goalie pull timing conditional on score/time
not_observed_by_these_sources: all whistles and the geometric basis of offside/icing calls
coach intent, exact line identity, fatigue, physical shot release points for blocked shots

event_rate_diagnostics.contexts: one axis at a time: all, side, event-time strength from PBP situationCode reconciled to left/right shift-interval limits, period, pre-event score state, time remaining; ambiguous/conflicting strength labels excluded

event_rate_diagnostics.exposure_definition: shift-derived team minutes; each side contributes its own team exposure
event_rate_diagnostics.rate_shrinkage: Gamma-Poisson mean with prior exposure equal to 20 times mean exposure per contributing training game; groups below 100 training events use the unconditioned parent rate

analysis_method_corrections: Source review found the initial clock-only penalty-pair prototype could select a same-second faceoff as if it preceded a penalty and could skip an immediate restart. Final overlap evidence uses sequence order and faceoff-delimited state transitions, requires clean shift-count agreement and no intervening goal, and reports penalty groups when service identity is ambiguous.

The legacy one-sided situation-code/shift comparison is retained in the JSON with its right-limit scope. Current conditional fitting uses two-sided event-state reconciliation and excludes unresolved or conflicting state labels.

Event-rate condition labels are now reconciled against both left-limit and right-limit shift interval states. The former single right-continuous shift snapshot is retained only as a comparison; boundary conflicts and unresolved labels are excluded from conditional-rate fitting.

ShotType, zoneCode, and goalie-ID conditional scores use observed-field complete cases and a baseline scored on the same events; because field availability can depend on recorded outcomes, these are retrospective selected-cohort diagnostics, not prospective skill claims. Missing values are not treated as predictive categories.
The final event-rate report retains the preregistered 2,000 game-cluster intervals for rates; descriptive Poisson-deviance differences are point estimates and are not separately bootstrapped.
Event-rate bootstrap intervals are expressed per 60 team-minutes, matching the reported point estimates; binary probability intervals remain on the probability scale.

model_diagnostics.development_scope: 2021 observed shot location/type and on-ice goalie are conditional diagnostic labels; they were not pregame inputs or fed into a simulation. Shot-type and zone comparisons use complete-case cohorts with matched parent losses. Blocked-shot events do not carry shotType, making that cohort outcome-selected. These scores are retrospective selected-cohort diagnostics, not prospective skill estimates.

prior_artifact_comparison.interpretation: Prior metrics are preserved for comparison. The prior all-attempt shotType result is not a valid prospective predictor: blocked-shot events have outcome-dependent missing shotType. This version emits shotType and zone comparisons only on the identical feature-present cohort, with a baseline scored on that cohort. Because cohort eligibility may itself depend on the recorded outcome, these are retrospective selected-cohort diagnostics, not prospective skill estimates. Goalie-ID comparisons likewise exclude missing IDs and use a same-cohort baseline; they remain retrospective conditional diagnostics.
